scope: Pinned provider build/ABI/math controls followed by native-only F16 resource and repeatability diagnostics; no original-model comparison or speed qualification.

subsequent_native_baseline.counter_scope: RUSAGE_SELF covers this process and its threads; no child work is included. Counters bracket perf_counter/run/perf_counter and are sampled outside the elapsed interval.
limitations: Native-only process: no original model or Torch is loaded.
Minor faults are fault events, not unique allocated pages; these counters do not attribute faults specifically to graph allocation.
System CPU time covers all kernel work and is not a measurement of page-fault latency.
CPU quota, dedicated capacity and host contention are unknown.
A single warmed call cannot establish comparative performance or qualify the backend.
subsequent_native_baseline.max_rss_semantics: Linux KiB process high-water mark, not current resident bytes; its delta is only an increase in the high-water mark.
subsequent_native_baseline.native_compute_precision: F32 activations/accumulation; CPU recurrent/FFT; gates=avx2_fma; fft=avx2
subsequent_native_baseline.scope: Modern-provider pre-cache baseline: one native warmup then one native full-pipeline call; output PCM and allocation counters retained, no original comparison or speed claim.
subsequent_native_baseline.timing_boundary: Unchanged NativeModel.run: public separation, chunking/normalization, owned CPU result conversion and native result release. Excludes loading, counters, hashes and receipt writes.
